<user_query>
Build a modern, luxury real estate landing page for a premium property platform 
that serves both buyers/renters AND sellers/landlords.

TECH STACK:
- Next.js 14 (App Router) with TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS for styling
- Framer Motion for subtle animations
- Lucide React for icons
- Use placeholder images from Unsplash (luxury homes)

DESIGN DIRECTION:
- Premium, elegant, minimalist aesthetic
- Color palette: Deep charcoal (#1a1a1a), warm gold accent (#c9a961), 
  soft cream (#f8f5f0), pure white
- Typography: Playfair Display (serif) for headings, Inter (sans-serif) for body
- Generous whitespace, sophisticated feel — think Sotheby's / LuxuryEstate
- Fully responsive (mobile-first)

PAGE STRUCTURE:

1. NAVBAR (sticky, transparent → solid on scroll)
   - Logo: "LUXE ESTATES" (or similar premium name)
   - Links: Buy, Rent, Sell, List Your Property, About, Contact
   - CTA button: "Get Started"

2. HERO SECTION
   - Full-screen background image of a luxury property (with dark overlay)
   - Headline: "Where Exceptional Homes Meet Exceptional People"
   - Subheadline: "Discover, buy, rent, or list the world's most prestigious properties."
   - Below headline: A SEGMENTED TOGGLE / TAB GROUP with 4 tabs:
       • Buy  • Rent  • Sell  • List for Rent
     - When a tab is selected, show relevant search inputs:
       * Buy/Rent → Location, Property Type, Price Range, Bedrooms + "Search" button
       * Sell/List → a short form: "Tell us about your property" + "Get Valuation" button
   - Alternatively, use 2 large toggle buttons: "I want to BUY or RENT" 
     vs "I want to SELL or LIST" that reveal the appropriate form below.

3. DUAL INTENT SECTION (the core of the request)
   Two side-by-side premium cards:
   
   Card A — "For Buyers & Renters"
     - Icon: search home
     - Headline: "Find Your Next Home"
     - Description: Browse handpicked luxury properties for sale and rent.
     - Two CTA buttons: [Buy a Property] [Rent a Property]
   
   Card B — "For Sellers & Landlords"
     - Icon: key / tag
     - Headline: "List Your Property"
     - Description: Reach qualified buyers and tenants seeking premium homes.
     - Two CTA buttons: [Sell My Property] [List for Rent]

4. FEATURED PROPERTIES SECTION
   - Section title: "Featured Listings"
   - Tabs above: [For Sale] [For Rent]
   - Grid of 6 property cards (3 cols desktop, 2 tablet, 1 mobile)
   - Each card: image, price, title, location, beds/baths/sqft, "For Sale" or "For Rent" badge
   - Hover: subtle scale + gold border

5. WHY CHOOSE US
   - 4 feature cards with icons:
     • Curated Premium Listings
     • Verified Buyers & Tenants
     • Dedicated Concierge Service
     • Transparent Deals

6. HOW IT WORKS (two-column)
   - Left: "For Buyers & Renters" — 3 steps
   - Right: "For Sellers & Landlords" — 3 steps

7. STATS BAR
   - $2B+ in properties sold | 5,000+ premium listings | 98% client satisfaction | 40+ cities

8. TESTIMONIALS
   - 3 cards with client photos, names, and quotes

9. CTA BANNER
   - "Ready to make your move?"
   - Two buttons: [Browse Properties] [List Your Property]

10. FOOTER
    - Logo + tagline
    - Columns: Buy, Rent, Sell, List, About, Contact
    - Social icons, newsletter signup
    - Copyright

INTERACTIONS:
- Smooth scroll between sections
- Tab switching with animated underline
- Fade-in-on-scroll animations (Framer Motion)
- Hover effects on all cards and buttons (gold glow / subtle lift)
- Mobile: hamburger menu, stacked layouts

DELIVERABLES:
- Clean, componentized code (Hero.tsx, DualIntent.tsx, FeaturedProperties.tsx, etc.)
- Reusable Button, Card, Tab components
- Fully responsive
- Accessible (proper ARIA labels on tabs/toggles)
- SEO-friendly metadata

Make it feel like a $10M+ real estate brand — elegant, trustworthy, and premium.
</user_query>
I'll set up a Next.js 14 luxury landing page as a dedicated project, then build the premium sections and components from the spec. First I'm checking how to create the app in this environment.

<user_query>
Build a paid property-viewing booking system on top of the existing LUXE ESTATES 
Next.js 14 app (App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind, Framer Motion). 

BUSINESS RULES (non-negotiable):
- Every viewing appointment costs ₹1,000, paid via UPI through Razorpay
- The fee is NON-REFUNDABLE except in one case: our team fails to show up 
  within 20 minutes of the scheduled time → full ₹1,000 refund to original UPI
- The fee IS adjustable against final commission when a deal closes 
  (tracked per client, not per booking)
- EVERY viewing costs ₹1,000 — even repeat viewings by the same client. 
  No free re-books.
- Client identity is phone-based (no OTP in v1) — phone is the unique key
- Admin dashboard is NOT password protected for now (single-user, will add 
  auth later). Put it at /admin/bookings.

TECH STACK:
- Razorpay (server SDK + client checkout)
- Supabase (Postgres + service role on server)
- Resend (transactional email)
- Zod (validation)

Follow these steps in order. After each step, confirm the build passes 
(`npm run build`) before moving to the next.

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
STEP 1 — INSTALL DEPENDENCIES
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
npm install razorpay @supabase/supabase-js zod resend
npm install -D @types/node

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
STEP 2 — SUPABASE SCHEMA
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
Create docs/supabase-schema.sql with the following SQL. Do NOT run it — 
it's for me to paste into the Supabase SQL editor. Print the SQL clearly 
in a file so I can copy it.

-- bookings table
create table bookings (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  client_phone text not null,
  client_name text not null,
  client_email text not null,
  property_id text not null,
  property_title text not null,
  viewing_date date not null,
  viewing_slot text not null,
  amount integer not null default 1000,
  status text not null default 'pending_payment',
    -- pending_payment | confirmed | failed | cancelled
  outcome text default 'pending',
    -- pending | completed | client_noshow | team_noshow | cancelled
  razorpay_order_id text,
  razorpay_payment_id text,
  razorpay_signature text,
  refund_status text default 'none',
    -- none | requested | processing | refunded | failed
  refund_id text,
  refund_reason text,
  adjusted_in_commission boolean default false,
  created_at timestamptz default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz default now()
);

create index on bookings (client_phone);
create index on bookings (status);
create index on bookings (viewing_date);

-- trigger to auto-update updated_at
create or replace function set_updated_at()
returns trigger as $$
begin new.updated_at = now(); return new; end;
$$ language plpgsql;

create trigger bookings_updated_at
  before update on bookings
  for each row execute function set_updated_at();

-- client summary view
create or replace view client_summary as
select
  client_phone,
  max(client_name) as client_name,
  max(client_email) as client_email,
  count(*) filter (where status = 'confirmed') as paid_viewings,
  sum(amount) filter (where status = 'confirmed' 
    and adjusted_in_commission = false) as total_adjustable,
  max(created_at) as last_booking
from bookings
group by client_phone;

Also create lib/supabase.ts exporting:
  - supabaseAdmin: uses SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY (server-only)
  - supabasePublic: uses NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY (client)

Guard supabaseAdmin so it throws if imported client-side.

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
STEP 3 — RAZORPAY SERVER WRAPPER
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
Create lib/razorpay.ts:
- Import Razorpay from "razorpay"
- Instantiate with key_id + key_secret from env
- Export helpers:
    createOrder({ amount, receipt, notes }) → returns order
    verifySignature({ orderId, paymentId, signature }) → boolean 
      (HMAC SHA256 using key_secret)
    createRefund({ paymentId, amount, notes }) → refund object
- All three are server-only. Throw if NEXT_PUBLIC env vars are used.

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
STEP 4 — ZOD SCHEMAS + TYPES
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
Create lib/schemas.ts:
  bookingSchema = z.object({
    clientName: z.string().min(2).max(100),
    clientPhone: z.string().regex(/^[6-9]\d{9}$/, "Enter a valid 10-digit Indian mobile number"),
    clientEmail: z.string().email(),
    propertyId: z.string().min(1),
    propertyTitle: z.string().min(1),
    viewingDate: z.string().refine(d => new Date(d) > new Date(), "Date must be in the future"),
    viewingSlot: z.enum(["10:00","11:00","12:00","14:00","15:00","16:00","17:00"]),
    termsAccepted: z.literal(true),
  });

Also export the Booking row type matching the Supabase schema.

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
STEP 5 — EMAIL TEMPLATES (RESEND)
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
Create lib/email.ts using Resend:
  sendBookingConfirmationToClient(booking)  — subject "Your LUXE ESTATES viewing 
    is confirmed", includes booking ref, property, date, slot, amount, 
    policy reminder
  sendBookingAlertToTeam(booking) — to TEAM_NOTIFICATION_EMAIL, includes all 
    client details + click-through to /admin/bookings/[id]
  sendRefundConfirmationToClient(booking, refundId) — team-no-show refund
Keep templates as plain HTML strings with inline styles (no React Email yet).
Use NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL in links.

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
STEP 6 — API ROUTES
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

app/api/bookings/route.ts  (POST)
  - Validate body with bookingSchema
  - Reject if same phone already has a confirmed booking for the 
    SAME property and SAME date+slot (anti-spam)
  - Insert booking row with status='pending_payment'
  - Call createOrder({ amount: 100000, receipt: booking.id, notes: {...} })
    (Razorpay wants paise, so ₹1000 = 100000)
  - Update booking with razorpay_order_id
  - Return { bookingId, orderId, amount, currency: "INR", key: PUBLIC_KEY_ID }

app/api/payments/verify/route.ts  (POST)

-- LUXE ESTATES viewing bookings
-- Paste this into the Supabase SQL editor and run it once.

-- bookings table
create table bookings (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  client_phone text not null,
  client_name text not null,
  client_email text not null,
  property_id text not null,
  property_title text not null,
  viewing_date date not null,
  viewing_slot text not null,
  amount integer not null default 1000,
  status text not null default 'pending_payment',
    -- pending_payment | confirmed | failed | cancelled
  outcome text default 'pending',
    -- pending | completed | client_noshow | team_noshow | cancelled
  razorpay_order_id text,
  razorpay_payment_id text,
  razorpay_signature text,
  refund_status text default 'none',
    -- none | requested | processing | refunded | failed
  refund_id text,
  refund_reason text,
  adjusted_in_commission boolean default false,
  created_at timestamptz default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz default now()
);

create index on bookings (client_phone);
create index on bookings (status);
create index on bookings (viewing_date);

-- trigger to auto-update updated_at
create or replace function set_updated_at()
returns trigger as $$
begin new.updated_at = now(); return new; end;
$$ language plpgsql;

create trigger bookings_updated_at
  before update on bookings
  for each row execute function set_updated_at();

-- client summary view
create or replace view client_summary as
select
  client_phone,
  max(client_name) as client_name,
  max(client_email) as client_email,
  count(*) filter (where status = 'confirmed') as paid_viewings,
  sum(amount) filter (where status = 'confirmed'
    and adjusted_in_commission = false) as total_adjustable,
  max(created_at) as last_booking
from bookings
group by client_phone;

Check out our [Next.js deployment documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/deploying) for more details.

## Booking & Payments

Paid viewings are ₹1,000 each, charged via Razorpay UPI. Copy `.env.local.example` to `.env.local` and fill in the keys below.

### Razorpay

1. Create a Razorpay account and switch to **Test Mode**.
2. From API Keys, set:
   - `RAZORPAY_KEY_ID` and `NEXT_PUBLIC_RAZORPAY_KEY_ID` (same test key id)
   - `RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET` (server only — never prefix with `NEXT_PUBLIC_`)
3. Webhooks → Add endpoint:
   - URL: `https://yourdomain.com/api/webhooks/razorpay`
   - Events: `payment.captured`, `payment.failed`, `refund.processed`
   - Paste the webhook secret into `RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET`

**Test UPI / cards:** use Razorpay’s [test payment methods](https://razorpay.com/docs/payments/payments/test-card-upi-details/). In test mode, UPI collect and success/failure cards complete checkout without real money.

### Supabase

1. Create a project and copy the URL, anon key, and service role key into `.env.local`.
2. Open the SQL editor and paste `docs/supabase-schema.sql` exactly as written, then run it. That creates `bookings`, indexes, the `updated_at` trigger, and the `client_summary` view.

### Resend

Set `RESEND_API_KEY`, `RESEND_FROM_EMAIL` (a verified domain or Resend’s onboarding sender), and `TEAM_NOTIFICATION_EMAIL` for concierge alerts.

### Refunds

Open `/admin/bookings`, select a confirmed booking, and click **Team No-Show → Refund ₹1,000**. That is the only refund path: the team missed the 20-minute window, Razorpay refunds the original UPI, and the client receives email confirmation. There is no auth on `/admin/bookings` yet — add it before production.

### Book a viewing

Property ids are slugs (for example `/book/villa-aurelia`), not numeric ids. Each property card on the home page links to its booking form.

**Business rules encoded**
- Every viewing is ₹1,000 (Razorpay amount `100000` paise)
- Duplicate confirmed bookings for the same phone + property + date + slot are rejected; repeat viewings on a new slot still pay ₹1,000
- Refunds only via **Team No-Show** on `/admin/bookings/[id]` (20-minute no-show), back to the original UPI
- Commission adjustment is per client (`client_summary` + Adjusted toggle), not per booking
- Identity key is phone; `/admin/bookings` has no auth (TODO comment in place)
